const result = $json.decisionResult || {};
return [{ json: { ok: true, phase: $json.phase, decision: result.decision || 'human_review', score: Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(result.score) || 0)), taskSpec: String(result.taskSpec || '').slice(0, 12000), summary: String(result.summary || '').slice(0, 4000), risks: Array.isArray(result.risks) ? result.risks.slice(0, 12).map(String) : [], acceptanceEvidence: Array.isArray(result.acceptanceEvidence) ? result.acceptanceEvidence.slice(0, 20).map(String) : [], answer: String(result.answer || '').slice(0, 4000), meta: { model: $json.modelUsed || 'unknown', iteration: $json.iteration, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } } }];
